info.title: RoomCircuit
info.author: LANywhere contributors
info.description: Switch Local Wireless over the internet
info.details: RoomCircuit brings Switch Local Wireless online with room browsing, custom nodes, and scheduling. Choose servers from the Ultrahand overlay; settings are stored in /config/RoomCircuit/. Requires Atmosphère and replaces the ldn_mitm module with the same ID. Restart after installation.\n\nSome code was generated with AI.

changelog: Choose servers in the Ultrahand overlay and move settings to /config/RoomCircuit/.
